advanced/index.title: Advanced Tutorials
advanced/index.description: This section is not going to be very structured, but we will cover the following topics:

advanced/plugins.title: Plugins
advanced/plugins.description: Plugins are the building blocks of features in a Docusaurus site. Each plugin handles its own individual feature. Plugins may work and be distributed as part of a bundle via presets.

advanced/routing.title: Routing
advanced/routing.description: Docusaurus' routing system follows single-page application conventions: one route, one component.

advanced/ssg.title: Static site generation (SSG)
advanced/ssg.description: Docusaurus statically renders your React code into HTML, allowing faster load speed and better SEO.

api/docusaurus.config.js.title: docusaurus.config.js
api/docusaurus.config.js.description: API reference for Docusaurus configuration file.

api/misc/create-docusaurus.title: 📦 create-docusaurus
api/misc/create-docusaurus.description: A scaffolding utility to help you instantly set up a functional Docusaurus app.

api/misc/eslint-plugin/no-html-links.title: no-html-links
api/misc/eslint-plugin/no-html-links.description: Ensure that the Docusaurus ` component is used instead of ` tags.

api/misc/eslint-plugin/no-untranslated-t.title: no-untranslated-text
api/misc/eslint-plugin/no-untranslated-t.description: Enforce text labels in JSX to be wrapped by translate calls.

api/misc/eslint-plugin/prefer-docusaurus.title: prefer-docusaurus-heading
api/misc/eslint-plugin/prefer-docusaurus.description: Ensures that the @theme/Heading theme component provided by Docusaurus theme-classic is used instead of `` tags for headings.

api/misc/eslint-plugin/README.title: 📦 eslint-plugin
api/misc/eslint-plugin/README.description: ESLint is a tool that statically analyzes your code and reports problems or suggests best practices through editor hints and command line. Docusaurus provides an ESLint plugin to enforce best Docusaurus practices.

api/misc/eslint-plugin/string-literal-i1.title: string-literal-i18n-messages
api/misc/eslint-plugin/string-literal-i1.description: Enforce translate APIs to be called on plain text labels.

api/misc/logger/logger.title: 📦 logger
api/misc/logger/logger.description: An encapsulated logger for semantically formatting console messages.

api/plugin-methods/extend-infrastructure.title: Extending infrastructure
api/plugin-methods/extend-infrastructure.description: Docusaurus has some infrastructure like hot reloading, CLI, and swizzling, that can be extended by external plugins.

api/plugin-methods/i18n-lifecycles.title: I18n lifecycles
api/plugin-methods/i18n-lifecycles.description: Plugins use these lifecycles to load i18n-related data.

api/plugin-methods/lifecycle-apis.title: Lifecycle APIs
api/plugin-methods/lifecycle-apis.description: During the build, plugins are loaded in parallel to fetch their own contents and render them to routes. Plugins may also configure webpack or post-process the generated files.

api/plugin-methods/README.title: Plugin Method References
api/plugin-methods/README.description: This section is a work in progress. Anchor links or even URLs are not guaranteed to be stable.

api/plugin-methods/static-methods.title: Static methods
api/plugin-methods/static-methods.description: Static methods are not part of the plugin instance—they are attached to the constructor function. These methods are used to validate and normalize the plugin options and theme config, which are then used as constructor parameters to initialize the plugin instance.

api/plugins/plugin-client-redirects.title: 📦 plugin-client-redirects
api/plugins/plugin-client-redirects.description: Docusaurus Plugin to generate client-side redirects.

api/plugins/plugin-content-blog.title: 📦 plugin-content-blog
api/plugins/plugin-content-blog.description: Provides the Blog feature and is the default blog plugin for Docusaurus.

api/plugins/plugin-content-docs.title: 📦 plugin-content-docs
api/plugins/plugin-content-docs.description: Provides the Docs functionality and is the default docs plugin for Docusaurus.

api/plugins/plugin-content-pages.title: 📦 plugin-content-pages
api/plugins/plugin-content-pages.description: The default pages plugin for Docusaurus. The classic template ships with this plugin with default configurations. This plugin provides creating pages functionality.

api/plugins/plugin-css-cascade-layers.title: 📦 plugin-css-cascade-layers
api/plugins/plugin-css-cascade-layers.description: This plugin is mostly designed to be used internally by the classic preset through the Docusaurus future.v4.useCssCascadeLayers flag, although it can also be used as a standalone plugin. Please let us know here if you have a use case for it and help us design an API that makes sense for the future of Docusaurus.

api/plugins/plugin-debug.title: 📦 plugin-debug
api/plugins/plugin-debug.description: The debug plugin will display useful debug information at http3000/docusaurus/debug.

api/plugins/plugin-google-analytics.title: 📦 plugin-google-analytics
api/plugins/plugin-google-analytics.description: The default Google Analytics plugin. It is a JavaScript library for measuring how users interact with your website in the production build. If you are using Google Analytics 4 you might need to consider using plugin-google-gtag instead.

api/plugins/plugin-google-gtag.title: 📦 plugin-google-gtag
api/plugins/plugin-google-gtag.description: The default Global Site Tag (gtag.js) plugin. It is a JavaScript tagging framework and API that allows you to send event data to Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Google Marketing Platform. This section describes how to configure a Docusaurus site to enable global site tag for Google Analytics.

api/plugins/plugin-google-tag-manager.title: 📦 plugin-google-tag-manager
api/plugins/plugin-google-tag-manager.description: A plugin for adding Google Tag Manager (gtm.js) to a Docusaurus site. Use this plugin in conjunction with the standard gtag plugin for in-depth analysis of how users are using your site.

api/plugins/plugin-ideal-image.title: 📦 plugin-ideal-image
api/plugins/plugin-ideal-image.description: Docusaurus Plugin to generate an almost ideal image (responsive, lazy-loading, and low quality placeholder).

api/plugins/plugin-pwa.title: 📦 plugin-pwa
api/plugins/plugin-pwa.description: Docusaurus Plugin to add PWA support using Workbox. This plugin generates a Service Worker in production build only, and allows you to create fully PWA-compliant documentation site with offline and installation support.

api/plugins/plugin-rsdoctor.title: 📦 plugin-rsdoctor
api/plugins/plugin-rsdoctor.description: A Rsdoctor plugin can help you troubleshoot the bundling phase of your Docusaurus site, supporting both Webpack and Rspack.

api/plugins/plugin-sitemap.title: 📦 plugin-sitemap
api/plugins/plugin-sitemap.description: This plugin creates sitemaps for your site so that search engine crawlers can crawl your site more accurately.

api/plugins/plugin-svgr.title: 📦 plugin-svgr
api/plugins/plugin-svgr.description: An SVGR plugin to transform SVG files into React components automatically at build time.

api/plugins/plugin-vercel-analytics.title: 📦 plugin-vercel-analytics
api/plugins/plugin-vercel-analytics.description: Vercel Analytics provides comprehensive insights into your website's visitors, tracking top pages, referrers, and demographics like location, operating systems, and browser info.

api/themes/theme-configuration.title: Theme configuration
api/themes/theme-configuration.description: This configuration applies to all main themes.

api/themes/theme-live-codeblock.title: 📦 theme-live-codeblock
api/themes/theme-live-codeblock.description: This theme provides a @theme/CodeBlock component that is powered by react-live. You can read more on interactive code editor documentation.

api/themes/theme-mermaid.title: 📦 theme-mermaid
api/themes/theme-mermaid.description: This theme provides a @theme/Mermaid component that is powered by mermaid. You can read more on diagrams documentation.

api/themes/theme-search-algolia.title: 📦 theme-search-algolia
api/themes/theme-search-algolia.description: This theme provides a @theme/SearchBar component that integrates with Algolia DocSearch easily. Combined with @docusaurus/theme-classic, it provides a very easy search integration. You can read more on search documentation.

guides/docs/versioning.description: You can use the versioning CLI to create a new documentation version based on the latest content in the docs directory. That specific set of documentation will then be preserved and accessible even as the documentation in the docs directory continues to evolve.

using-plugins.title: Using Plugins
using-plugins.description: The Docusaurus core doesn't provide any feature of its own. All features are delegated to individual plugins: the docs feature provided by the docs plugin; the blog feature provided by the blog plugin; or individual pages provided by the pages plugin. If there are no plugins installed, the site won't contain any routes.
